source_text: From the 30 specimens genotyped for East-kdr, a single hybrid (M/S) mosquito appeared to be heterozygous for the mutation (Figure 1). All the other samples ('f') displayed the susceptible alleles.

Based on the fact that this specimen was heterozygous, it was further characterized for West-kdr to verify that it was not a double mutation West-East-kdr. However, it appeared to be negative for the West-kdr mutation.
